prompts.prompt: Use case: compositing + identity-preserve. Asset: production transparent expression sprite atlas for Mia in GoForDeutsch. Input 1 is the existing BASE 3x2 Mia sheet; input 2 is the EXTRA 3x2 Mia sheet with five portraits; input 3 is the IDLE two-portrait open-eyes/closed-eyes pair. These are EDIT TARGETS and exact character-identity sources, not loose style inspirations. Reorganize the existing portraits into ONE perfectly aligned atlas containing 12 cells, exactly FOUR equal columns and THREE equal rows. Overall canvas aspect ratio 8:9 (for example 1536x1728), each cell aspect 2:3. All 12 characters identical torso crop, head scale, eye line, proportions, uniform, ponytail and face. Match the original brown shoulder-length hair, short side ponytail on viewer right, pink bow, amber eyes, opaque white blouse with pink edging and pink necktie, blue skirt upper edge with white laces. Youthful age-appropriate anime artwork, no style change. Preserve the original appearances, poses and expressions as faithfully as possible. The ONLY expression to REPLACE is the weary frowning half-lidded face from input2 row2 col2. Replace it with FRIENDLY ATTENTIVE FOCUS: eyes fully open and engaged, eyebrows relaxed level/slightly lifted, small warm closed-mouth smile, upright posture with a hand lightly near chin or collarbone. It must feel patient, curious and supportive, never angry, sulking, bored, judgmental, sad or condescending. No cheek resting in palm, no furrowed eyebrows, no narrowed eyes. EXACT OUTPUT CELL ORDER: row1 col1 neutral eyes-open gentle smile from input3 left; row1 col2 SAME neutral portrait with both eyelids briefly closed from input3 right, must match row1 col1 in body/head geometry exactly for blink animation; row1 col3 thinking hand at chin from input1 row1 col2; row1 col4 talking open mouth from input1 row1 col3. Row2 col1 happy closed-eye smile from input1 row2 col1; row2 col2 encouraging raised index finger from input1 row2 col2; row2 col3 celebrating two small fists from input1 row2 col3; row2 col4 winking and waving from input2 row1 col1. Row3 col1 surprised small O mouth from input2 row1 col2; row3 col2 proud soft smile with hands clasped from input2 row1 col3; row3 col3 pondering upward gaze and finger near chin from input2 row2 col1; row3 col4 the NEW friendly attentive focus expression. No missing or duplicate states, no extra characters. Each character entirely within their own cell with small transparent safety margins; no cuts to hair, bow, hands, no cell bleed. Align all portrait tops and torso bottoms carefully, preserve uniform eye line. Actual transparent alpha=0 background around each character, no checkerboard drawing, no background colors, no frames, no dividers, no captions, no letters, no watermark or signatures. White shirts must stay opaque. Clean silhouette edges with no stray colored pixels or glow. Output only the single transparent atlas.

Use case: precise-object-edit / identity-preserve. EDIT TARGET: the provided transparent 4-column, 3-row Mia sprite atlas. Correct ONLY the blink frame in TOP ROW, SECOND COLUMN. The top-row FIRST COLUMN is the exact geometry master. Rebuild top-row SECOND COLUMN by copying that FIRST portrait at the identical local pixel coordinates within its tile: exactly the same hair outline and strands, bow, head silhouette, face shape and mouth, shoulders, shirt wrinkles, pink tie, arms, skirt and full body pose, size, eye-line and crop. Change ONLY the two open eyes into gently shut eyelids for a natural 130ms blink. No other geometric or facial change. The first two tiles must have perfectly matching silhouette and alignment, so alternating them does not move the character at all. In the current second tile the head/body is offset compared with first; remove that offset. Keep the entire atlas canvas, same exact FOUR equal columns and THREE equal rows, same 8:9 overall aspect, same framing and tile order. Preserve ALL OTHER ELEVEN tiles as faithfully/pixel-identically as possible, especially the friendly open-eyed smiling focus face in BOTTOM RIGHT. Do not redraw the other poses, do not add or omit states. TRUE TRANSPARENT alpha outside every character, white shirts fully opaque, no background, no checkerboard, no glow, no borders, captions or text. Return only the corrected single 12-state transparent atlas.

prompts.prompt: Use case: compositing / precise sprite-layout edit. Edit target: the provided 12-expression transparent Mia atlas. Keep all twelve expressions, same order, same character identity, outfit, face and poses, including the new friendly smiling attentive focus in bottom-right. Improve ONLY production layout and spacing. Output exact 4 equal columns x 3 equal rows; overall 8:9 canvas. Each tile is an independent 2:3 rectangle. Repack each portrait inside its own equal tile with generous 12% COMPLETELY TRANSPARENT left/right safety margins and 5% top/bottom safety margins. All hair, ponytail, bow, fingers and torso MUST remain inside its own tile. No body parts or stray fragments may enter a neighboring tile. This is crucial: the previous layout's first-column ponytails and the waving hand spill into adjacent tiles, which shows unwanted floating fragments when cropped by a game. Uniformly make the figures smaller enough to fit, without clipping a single finger. Give every portrait the same head scale, eye line, centered face and torso baseline. Four portrait face centers at exactly 12.5%,37.5%,62.5%,87.5% of canvas width. Top-row first and second portraits MUST be the exact same neutral pose, same pixel-local hair silhouette, bow, face geometry, hands at sides, shoulders and clothing. Copy the first neutral pose to the second tile; the ONLY difference is open eyes versus closed eyelids, for a blink with zero head/body motion. Do not redraw a different body/head in the blink tile. Remaining states unchanged in order: row1 smile/blink/thinking/talking, row2 happy/encourage/celebrate/wink, row3 surprised/proud/ponder/friendly focus. Do not add, omit, swap or duplicate poses. No anger, sulking or bored expressions. TRUE alpha transparency throughout all margins, not a background color or a checkerboard. White clothing opaque. Clean isolated silhouette edges. No text, frames, dividers, logos or watermark. One production sprite sheet only.
